content: Oseltamivir is available in the following forms and strengths: TAMIFLU Capsules: 1. 30-mg Capsules: Each capsule contains 30 mg of oseltamivir free base, equivalent to the phosphate salt. These capsules are light yellow, hard gelatin capsules. The body of the capsule is imprinted with ROCHE in blue ink, and the cap is imprinted with 30 mg in blue ink. They are supplied in blister packages containing 10 capsules (NDC 0004-0802-85). 2. 45-mg Capsules: Each capsule contains 45 mg of oseltamivir free base, equivalent to the phosphate salt. These capsules are grey, hard gelatin capsules. The body of the capsule is imprinted with ROCHE in blue ink, and the cap is imprinted with 45 mg in blue ink. They are supplied in blister packages containing 10 capsules (NDC 0004-0801-85). 3. 75-mg Capsules: Each capsule contains 75 mg of oseltamivir free base, equivalent to the phosphate salt. These capsules are grey and light yellow, hard gelatin capsules. The body of the capsule is imprinted with ROCHE in blue ink, and the cap is imprinted with 75 mg in blue ink. They are supplied in blister packages containing 10 capsules (NDC 0004-0800-85). Storage Instructions for Capsules: Store the capsules at a controlled room temperature of 25°C (77°F). Temperature excursions between 15°C and 30°C (59°F to 86°F) are permitted. TAMIFLU for Oral Suspension: This formulation is supplied as a white powder blend contained in a glass bottle. After reconstitution, the powder produces a white, tutti-frutti–flavored oral suspension. When 55 mL of water is added to the powder, the resulting suspension provides a total usable volume of 60 mL. This suspension contains 360 mg of oseltamivir base, equivalent to a concentration of 6 mg/mL (NDC 0004-0822-05). Storage Instructions for Oral Suspension: Dry Powder: Store the dry powder at a controlled room temperature of 25°C (77°F). Temperature excursions between 15°C and 30°C (59°F to 86°F) are permitted. Reconstituted Suspension: If refrigerated, store the suspension at 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F) for up to 17 days. Do not freeze. Alternatively, if stored at room temperature, the suspension can be kept at 25°C (77°F) for up to 10 days. Temperature excursions between 15°C and 30°C (59°F to 86°F) are permitted.
